subhypotheses.claim: The conventional diffraction scale is conditional on a specified far-field imaging model.
Localization precision, separation resolution, structural resolution, and coordinate accuracy require separate reporting.
SIM, STED/RESOLFT, SMLM, MINFLUX, and expansion/sequential strategies gain information through different mechanisms and trade-offs.
Task-specific calibration and artifact assessment are needed before a structural-resolution claim.
A shared evidence record can be proposed to make super-resolution claims auditable across modalities.

prohibited_inferences: Do not describe any single numerical precision as universal structural resolution.
Do not state that the study executed microscope acquisition, reconstruction, or biological measurement.
Do not treat a visual sharpening algorithm as physical recovery without calibrated validation.
